title: Nicole:
headline: A mom in treatment swipes her card for groceries and it does not clear. Family Reach gives her room to breathe.
story: Nicole is a real estate agent in Brockton. She was having her best year when cancer stopped her work. The savings went fast. Her card was declined at the grocery register, and her lights were shut off. Family Reach helped her pay the car note, the light bill and her cards.

One family, one money problem, one thing Family Reach fixed. The shame at the register is the hook; “I was able to breathe” is the turn. Warm and hopeful at the end. This is a shorter cut of your approved long-form, for Instagram and TikTok.
